text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif
text.tspan: Contribution to global mean surface temperature rise by gas

tspan.font-family: Lato, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

text.tspan: The global mean surface temperature change as a result of a country or region's cumulative emissions of three gases –
carbon dioxide, methane, and nitrous oxide.

tspan.tspan: This does not include cooling impacts from sulphur dioxide and aerosols, so the net warming can be lower.
